To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the PV-Powered SR drive with fuzzy logic controller can be used for electric vehicle applications.
the proposed system is able to achieve higher efficiency and better performance with reduced greenhouse gas emission.
a fuzzy logic controller is developed for the tri-port converter to control the energy exchange between PV panel, battery, and SRM drive.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a fuzzy controller based on a hybrid energy system (PV-SRM) for electric vehicle application.
a novel energy management strategy based on fuzzy logic control for the tri-port converter in the HEV.
a fuzzy logic controller (FLC)-based tri-port converter to control the energy flows between PV panel, on-board battery and SRM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed system can be used to control the energy flows between the PV panel and battery bank, which can be further utilized in the SRM drive.
, the proposed system has the ability to increase the driving miles by 10% and 20% in urban and highway conditions respectively.
the proposed system can increase the range of the EVs and also it can provide a better driving experience for the passengers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the proposed system provides a better performance with respect to the existing systems.
the proposed system can be implemented in the real world with the existing battery bank and SRM drive in the Electric vehicles with the addition of PV panel.
the proposed system is a good solution for the energy management of EVs and can be implemented in real time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed tri-port converter can be operated in six modes to control the energy flows among PV, battery, and SRM drive.
, the proposed fuzzy logic controller is capable of operating the tri-port converter in all the six operational modes.
, the fuzzy based controller can be used to control the energy transfer in the tri-port converter for the SRM drive in EVs.
